input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "liability" return only the no-joint-venture clause), and Section 9 (Warranties) is limited to corporate authority reps plus the Globix carve-out. HDI designs, hosts and operates the Site and supplies the underlying software and technology, so the absence of any HDI IP-infringement indemnity falls into walk-away territory under the rule. Inserted the preferred HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information/user data, gross negligence or wilful misconduct) with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics as new Section 9(c), which also brings it within the existing Section 10.7 survival list; no Company indemnity was added, and an IP-only fallback with customary exclusions and remedies is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data/Content breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) at end of Section 9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity of any kind, so we have no protection if the Site or HDI's services draw a third-party IP claim or if HDI's conduct causes loss. We have added a standard HDI indemnity with the usual notice, control and cooperation mechanics; placing it in Section 9 keeps it within the existing survival provision. If HDI prefers, we can narrow this to an IP-only indemnity with the customary exclusions (Company Content, Company-directed modifications and combinations) and procure/modify/replace remedies.

ops.text: Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, the Services or any other materials, software or technology provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right (excluding any claim to the extent arising from Content supplied by the Company); (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information or user data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt written notice of the claim, HDI shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the Company shall be entered into without the Company's prior written consent), and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.
